title: Configuration of the core
description: The one logical model of the configuration of the core, shared by both languages (REQ-CFG-001). The library reads no file and no environment (ADR-004, REQ-ARC-007): the consumer loads these values with its own tool, using the names of x-env, and passes them in. The defaults and the profiles are code (the profile functions), not part of this schema, and an empty text means 'not set'. No field here is a secret (REQ-CFG-005); the settings of an adapter belong to the adapter, never an adapter name here (REQ-ARC-013). The order of the properties is the order in which a validation reports its problems.

resource.description: The identity of the emitting process (section 5.2 of PR-001).

service_name.description: Logical name of the service. Required.

instance_id.description: Instance id. When empty the core generates one at start with the identifier generator port.

service_version.description: The version of the service. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the source, for display only (ADR-012). Optional.

delivery.description: How events leave the process (section 10 of PR-001).

mode.description: The delivery mode: best_effort, retry or durable (contracts/enums/delivery_mode.json). The profile gives the default.

queue_size.description: Events held in the bounded queue (default 10000).

batch_size.description: Events in one batch (default 100). Not greater than queue_size.

timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds before a network operation gives up (default 3000, REQ-DLV-004).

limits.description: The size limits of T-03.5 (REQ-SEC-004, REQ-CTR-010).

max_attribute_value_chars.description: Characters of a string attribute value (default 256).

max_event_bytes.description: Bytes of the canonical JSON of one event (default 65536).

max_batch_bytes.description: Bytes of one HTTP batch (default 1048576). Not less than max_event_bytes.

spool.description: The local spool of the durable mode (section 10.4 of PR-001). The adapter is T-06.

directory.description: Directory of the spool. Required when the delivery mode is durable; the consumer gives it, there is no default.

quota_bytes.description: Disk quota of the spool per destination (default 268435456, 256 MiB).

masking.description: The options of the masking of T-03.4 (REQ-SEC-001 to REQ-SEC-003).

extra_patterns.description: Extra regular expressions whose matches are hidden. Keep to the subset common to Go and Python.

field_names.description: When set (even empty) it REPLACES the default list of sensitive field names; when not set the default list is used.

extra_field_names.description: Field names added to the active list.

class_rules.description: Class name to rule: drop, redact or allow.
